reason: Development dependency of @vscode/vsce through @azure/identity (no release of @azure/identity allows the fixed @azure/msal-node 7.1 yet). The advisory affects only the authorization code flow (acquireTokenByCode); vsce authenticates with EnvironmentCredential, AzureCliCredential, ManagedIdentityCredential, AzurePowerShellCredential and AzureDeveloperCliCredential, none of which use it. Remove when @azure/identity accepts @azure/msal-node >=7.1.0.
